# DR-1376: He that answereth a matter before he heareth it — the test that made the machine ask, the counsel that argues before it answers, and why a score is not a healing (sov73)

**THE REST OF THE SEND IS NOT SPENT.** The MIT island study of thirteen unsupervised agents, the Monte Carlo launch-date method, the Treasury investment proposal, the reported DeepSeek raise, the four banks blocking third-party agents, the proof effort across 123 libraries, the Barclays job cuts, Canva Craft, the agent credential-holder, the live translator, the question-routing interface and the opinion column are **untouched and still available to a later week** — one TEACHING one lesson, never one SOURCE one lesson. **The second number in the subject line is NOT a second teaching:** the reported 30 billion dollar raise at a 1.25 trillion dollar valuation is the SAME teaching wearing money — a number spoken about a matter not yet heard — so it takes a movement rather than a lesson.

## Context

Darrell forwarded one newsletter with one word above the header: *"Lesson."* One item of it is the occasion. That item reports a diagnostic system scoring far above physicians on hard journal cases, describes the benchmark it was scored on, and prints the publication's own cautions beside its own headline: a simulation with no real patients, physicians who were working alone, and most of the gain coming from the models underneath the panel.

## What was measured

**The provenance, first, because it governs every claim.** The forwarded newsletter is the ENTIRE source. **NOT ONE PRIMARY SOURCE WAS OPENED.** Four roads refused at the gateway with the refusal quoted rather than described — `curl: (56) CONNECT tunnel failed, response 403` for `microsoft.ai` (the company's own announcement), `arxiv.org` (the preprint describing the benchmark), `www.nejm.org` (the journal the cases are drawn from) and `www.bidmc.org` (the hospital where the promised study is to run) — and a fifth attempt through a different tool would not resolve at all: `getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND microsoft.ai`. `www.microsoft.com` answered **HTTP 200 in the same minute** and the egress proxy's own status log records the four as `connect_rejected` / *"gateway answered 403 to CONNECT (policy denial or upstream failure)"*, so this is a **per-host closed door, not a broken wire** — a distinction made by measurement rather than assumed. No secondary coverage was read either, per the build brief, so this is a **SECOND-HAND READ** start to finish and is labeled one in all four non-child places. `re-review: 2026-12-06` — re-read once any of those hosts is allowed.

**The three tiers (DR-0100), sorted claim by claim.** DOCUMENTED, measured here: the forward and its hour, the letter's own text, and the refusals above. ATTRIBUTED, carried as the publication's and never on our authority: 83% / 36% / 22% on hard cases, 80% / 47% on typical emergency cases, 304 hard journal cases, a cost at roughly half to a third with fewer tests, and the letter's own note that one model scored 78.9% alone with the orchestrating layer adding about four points. UNCHECKED and staying unchecked, named narrowly: every one of those figures; whether one living patient was helped (the letter reports the company itself calls real-world performance still to be tested); whether the comparison was like for like (the letter says the physicians were primary care doctors and general internists working **alone**); and the reported financing, which the letter itself hedges. The vendor's **"medical superintelligence"** framing is the **over-reach tier**: the lesson refuses the word and leaves the true result under it standing untouched, which is DR-0100's third tier exactly.

**What the checking CHANGED.** The draft expected to reach at least the company's announcement and the preprint and to quote the figures as the maker's own **published** figures. The probe reversed that: nothing opened, so every figure sits **two layers out** from anything measured — the maker said it, a newsletter reported that the maker said it, we read the newsletter — and the landing had to move **off the numbers entirely and onto the METHOD**, which the letter describes in its own words and which the Word has already judged. The closed door produced the better lesson.

**Four references the catalog had NEVER opened**, appearing in **no file** of `app/src` or `docs/decisions` with this lesson's own block cut out: **Genesis 18:21, John 5:6, Matthew 9:12 and 2 Chronicles 16:12.** Three of the four carry the hour's second and seventh movements — the Judge going down to see before He rules, Jesus asking a long-sick man whether he wants to be made whole, and Jesus naming whom a physician is for. **Mark 10:51** is a fifth first: it exists only in the therapy-lesson surface and DR-0345, and no course or class module of the taught catalog had ever taught it.

**The largest overlap is MEASURED and named, not avoided (DR-1317).** **14** shared teaching references with **sov33** (DR-0761) outside the seven standing Godhead-confession and growth verses, including the whole of **1 Kings 22:6-8**. The landings differ and the gate asserts both halves: sov33 reads that chapter for **the consensus that killed a king** and a tool trained on approval; sov73 reads it for **who assembled the panel** and whether anybody in it can **lose**. Not one reference was dropped for the overlap, and the census names the other holder for all 36 shared references.

**The reading ladder, measured on the shipped text:** child **1.43** (ceiling 5.0), youth **4.21**, teen **5.23** (6.0), senior **7.88** (10.0), strictly rising, adult at **8.01**; band shares **0.56 / 0.68 / 0.75 / 0.93** of the adult prose against floors 0.50 / 0.60; worst band-to-band overlap **0.136** and worst band-to-adult **0.199**, against the 0.25 near-copy line. The teen band first measured **6.40** and the senior **12.20** — both over their ceilings, and both repaired by splitting long sentences rather than by thinning the teaching. **A third finding was a bare assertion in my own child band:** it said the system *got more right than the doctors in the test did* as a flat fact, where every other place carries the figure as the publication's. It now reads *Here is what the company reported*, and the adult lesson names exactly what is being refused to shrink — the SHAPE of the claim rather than its arithmetic, which we never verified.

## Impact

The course gains the week that asks the question the speed argument never asks — not *was the answer right* but *was it answered before it was heard* — and five references the taught catalog had never opened are now taught, four of them nowhere in the repository at all. **The health boundary is built as a first-class requirement rather than a disclaimer:** every one of the five reader places sends a reader with something wrong to a physician, the four non-child places state plainly that nothing here diagnoses anything, and the gate has a describe block of its own that fails if any place softens it. **2 Chronicles 16:12 is taught for the OMISSION it actually charges** — *he sought not to the LORD* — with the lesson saying out loud that Scripture does not go on to forbid the physician and neither does it, which is DR-0098's reticence rule applied to the one verse in this spine a careless reading would turn into an argument against doctors. **Week 72 is in flight on a sibling branch**, so the gap is recorded ONCE, in `sovereign-ai-class.test.js`'s `HELD_IN_FLIGHT`, which fails the moment the hold outlives its week; this lesson's own gate makes **no contiguity claim at all** and no claim to be last, because duplicating that allowance would be a second place to forget to clear it. Until week 72 lands, the seven sibling gates that assert strict contiguity with no such allowance (sov57–sov63) are expected red — the measured asymmetry DR-1338 already recorded with `re-review: 2026-12-05`; not one of them was edited, because they go green on their own the moment the held week arrives, and weakening a gate to pass is the edit they exist to prevent.

## Decision

**sov73 ships as the Sovereign A.I. week on the sequence, the counsel and the score that is not a healing**, Word first, with its own pinned gate, honest in every reader place about never having opened a primary source. All 40 references were fetched from `app/public/bible/kjv` before a word was written and are pinned verbatim. Both stories are `kind: 'parable'` — no real person's life stands behind either, so neither wears the testimony label and DR-1123's pin stays put. No figure from the send is stated on our own authority, and no number is carried without the publication's own hedge.

## Verification

`sovereign-ai-sov73-verses.test.js` green: all 40 references pinned, each verbatim against `app/public/bible/kjv` and each quoted in the adult lesson with its citation; **proven to catch** by bending every one of the 40 fragments, by a named-near-miss case on the two spans most easily misremembered (Proverbs 18:13 modernized to *answers … hears*, and Mark 10:51 stripped of *And Jesus answered and said unto him*, which is the construction the whole second movement turns on), by breaking **ten** load-bearing markers at every site they appear, by softening **each** refusal in each non-child place, by dropping the SECOND-HAND READ label, by softening the health boundary in every place, and by planting a testimony; plus the DR-0795 proof that stripping the teen band's friend line alone is named by the per-band check while the pooled check stays green, and a not-hollow proof that the British-spelling scan reads our prose and leaves *honour* inside a quotation alone. No straight apostrophe inside a quotation (DR-0456); Yahweh never substituted into a quoted verse; no reader field recites a decision-record identifier. **`lesson-dates` regenerated by `npm run lesson-dates`** (904 of 904 lessons dated, 0 undated); the band baseline by `cd app && npx vite-node ../scripts/course-band-baseline-write.mjs` on the tree holding everything (total 464, allFour **290**, adultOnly 0, adultRegister 0; Sovereign A.I. reads `{lessons: 72, allFour: 51}`), with the pin set to what the script printed — never incremented by hand and never taken from either side of a merge, which is the fifth collision on that literal in two days (`re-review: 2026-11-13`). The clarity corpus was regenerated with `--write` and came back byte-identical. `business-systems-guard`, `record-length-guard`, `decision-citation-guard`, `file-budget-guard`, `lessons-gate-coverage`, `one-thread-one-record-guard` and `surface-hollow-guard` all OK; **lint clean** (`npx eslint src --max-warnings 0`, exit 0). **No case in this gate asserts anything about the tree** — no git ref, no branch state, no neighbour having merged — because a case that asserts about its environment passes in a worktree and goes red in CI.
